DUROFLEX VISUAL WORLD GUIDE
The starting point
Duroflex has moved from a clean identity system into a richer visual universe. The next job is not to add more templates. It is to define the world: the spaces, light, people, body language, category moods and graphic behaviour that make the brand unmistakably Duroflex.
Duroflex Visual World Guide  |  Draft Structure  |  2

DUROFLEX VISUAL WORLD GUIDE
Diagnosis: five visual languages today
The current deck has strong ingredients, but they are not yet governed by one master visual idea. The guide must bring them together as different rooms inside one restoration world.
• Identity: red, white, rounded panels
• Sofas: wine, olive, editorial luxury
• Mattresses: architecture, daylight, calm
• Massagers: black, tech, recovery
• Sale: high urgency, high contrast
Duroflex Visual World Guide  |  Draft Structure  |  3

THE CREATIVE NORTH STAR
The governing idea
The world gets quieter around a Duroflex product.
From stress → stillness → restoration → energy
